name: Khan Shaka
summary: Warug of the Magram now sends you after Khan Shaka, the Gelkis Khan. Bring him Shaka’s head so he can stare at it and laugh at his enemy.

sections.title: A Rival Khan
sections.body: In Magram Village, Warug says your help has pleased him and served the Magram well. Now he wants Khan Shaka, the Gelkis Khan, killed, and his head brought back. Warug means to stare at it and laugh at his enemy. He expects you to stay on good terms with the Magram.

faq.answer: Khan Shaka leads the Gelkis centaur clan in Desolace. Warug of the Magram wants his head.

faq.q: Why does Warug want Khan Shaka dead?
faq.answer: Warug wants Khan Shaka’s head so he can stare at it and laugh at his enemy.
Warug is in Magram Village in Desolace.
After Gizmo for Warug, Warug says he likes you for helping the Magram.
